data.name: GDScript Voxel Terrain
data.summary: A Godot 4 procedural voxel terrain engine that began as an editor-oriented sampled point-field visualizer and evolved into a modular offline generation and runtime streaming architecture. PointFieldResource is the authoritative regular-lattice scalar-field representation; visualization and meshers are consumers. Surface Nets is implemented as an algorithm consumer, ArrayMesh output exists, chunk assets and manifests provide the persisted terrain boundary, and ChunkStreamer handles runtime loading and target-relative residency of precomputed terrain. The project also has deterministic headless validation, dedicated validation scenes, GitHub Pages Integration Preview browser/mobile QA, shared mobile controls, version/release workflows, ADRs, performance evidence conventions, and a mutable ROADMAP.md. The long-term target is large precomputed terrain such as a several-kilometer asteroid, with generation and meshing remaining offline while runtime becomes primarily an asset-loading, residency, and eventual LOD problem. A dedicated Project Engineering Steward maintains canonical compact engineering memory in docs/project-chat-handoff.cove.json and a deterministic compatibility derivative in docs/project-chat-handoff.json, while Git, ADR, roadmap, test, and validation sources retain their higher source-of-truth roles.
